services.name: View Cruises
services.desc: Book a Pittsburgh dinner cruise aboard the Gateway Clipper! If you’re looking for a fun way to spend an evening in the city, you can’t go wrong with one of our unique dining options. From sunset dinners to wine tastings, these dinner cruises in Pittsburgh are sure to delight. You just can’t beat dinner with a view. Enjoy fabulous views of the city skyline as we cruise the three Pittsburgh rivers: the Ohio, Allegheny, and Monongahela. You’ll be treated to beautiful scenery as we pass historic landmarks and other points of interest along the rivers.
